facts.business: Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL) is a Mini Ratna company and a subsidiary of Coal India Limited engaged in the production and marketing of coal and coal products.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: (a) Revision of accounting treatment of Input GST on capital goods from capitalization to availing ITC as current assets effective 01.04.2025; (b) Physical verification of store items conducted for FY 2024-25 with financial impact not yet determined; (c) Partial confirmation of debit/credit balances including trade receivables, payables, and other liabilities with reconciliation in progress.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Board composition requirements (requisite number of Independent Directors not appointed as per Section 149(4) of Companies Act, 2013 and Regulation 17 of SEBI LODR)
Uncertain financial impact from physical verification of store items conducted during FY 2024-25
Partial confirmation and ongoing reconciliation of trade receivables, payables, and other balances
Change in GST rate on coal from 5% to 18% effective September 22, 2025 altering tax structure
